initiatives.name: Sustainable Finance and Community Investment
initiatives.summary: CIMB exceeded its sustainable finance target, achieving RM117 billion from 2021-2024, surpassing the RM100 billion target. The bank has set Net Zero by 2050 targets and completed 2030 decarbonisation target setting for high-emitting sectors covering 60% of financed emissions.

evidence.title: Sustainable Finance Target Achievement and New Goals
evidence.summary: CIMB exceeded its sustainable finance target, achieving RM117 billion from 2021-2024, surpassing the RM100 billion target. The bank has set Net Zero by 2050 targets and completed 2030 decarbonisation target setting for high-emitting sectors covering 60% of financed emissions.
evidence.quote: During the year, we surpassed our sustainable finance target, achieving a cumulative total of RM117 billion from 2021-2024 – exceeding the RM100 billion target, which tripled from our initial target of RM30 billion set in 2021.

evidence.title: Community Investment and CSR Initiatives
evidence.summary: CIMB allocated significant resources to community programs and CSR initiatives across the region, demonstrating commitment to being a responsible corporate citizen. The investment supports various social impact programs including financial literacy, economic empowerment and community development.
evidence.quote: A key advocate of economic inclusion, the Group remains committed to playing its role as a responsible corporate citizen, allocating approximately RM42 million between CSR initiatives and Zakat for 2024 regionally.

evidence.title: Direct Community Investment Program
evidence.summary: CIMB invested directly in local communities through various programs and volunteer initiatives, demonstrating commitment to social impact. The investment was complemented by significant employee volunteer hours across the region.
evidence.quote: INVESTED RM28.3 million and over 216,000 VOLUNTEER hours in local communities

initiatives.name: RPA and AI Automation Delivery
initiatives.summary: CIMB established the SBF Lab to incubate and deploy automation and digital solutions across the Group's key processes. The lab executed 30 projects delivering an estimated RM70 million in value as part of their automation and digitisation at scale initiative.

evidence.title: 130+ robotic process automation and AI use cases
evidence.summary: CIMB delivered over 130 robotic process automation (RPA) and AI use cases, achieving more than 75,000 man-hours saved and up to 80% reduction in processing times as part of their process efficiency and productivity gains.
evidence.quote: Process Efficiency and Productivity Gains: Delivered over 130 robotic process automation (RPA) and AI use cases, achieving more than 75,000 man-hours saved and up to 80% reduction in processing times.

evidence.title: SBF Lab automation delivering RM70 million value

initiatives.name: Sustainable Finance Commitment 2030
initiatives.summary: CIMB tripled their target from RM100 billion for the 2021-2024 period to RM300 billion through 2030. They have mobilised RM156.8 billion to date, with approximately 60% from sustainability-themed finance and 40% from economic inclusion for SMEs and low-income individuals.

initiatives.name: New Group CEO and Forward30 Strategy

evidence.title: Forward30 Strategic Plan Launch

initiatives.name: Board Leadership Transition

initiatives.name: Directors' Remuneration Framework Review
initiatives.summary: CIMB undertook a comprehensive review of its Non-Executive Directors' Remuneration Framework in 2025, the first since 2017. A revised fee structure was approved by shareholders at the 68th AGM held on 29 April 2025, including introduction of committee membership retainer fees.

evidence.title: Directors' Remuneration Framework Review

evidence.quote: In 2025, the Board undertook a comprehensive review of the NEDs' Remuneration Framework, the first since 2017, through an external benchmarking exercise. Based on consultant analysis of market trends and cost perspectives, a revised fee structure was approved by the Shareholders at the 68th AGM held on 29 April 2025.

initiatives.name: Machine Learning Credit Risk Models
initiatives.summary: CIMB has been developing and implementing machine learning models for credit risk assessment since 2019. These models enhance business lending through better customer insights, faster model delivery, and hybrid risk segmentation across retail and SME portfolios.

evidence.title: Machine Learning Risk Models Implementation

evidence.quote: To complement the Group's traditional rating models, Group Risk begun to develop stronger predictive risk models via cutting edge machine learning techniques since 2019.
